title: Mini-Discovery Artifact
description: Entry artifact produced by ticket-intake-agent (Stage 0) and enriched by codebase-context-agent. Consumed by the first routed phase orchestrator in implement-ticket.prompt.md. Contains the ticket identity, size classification, routed phases, and codebase context snapshot.

ticketIdentity.description: Identity fields from the source ticket.

issueKey.description: Validated issue key (e.g., TT-42). Must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[1-9][0-9]*$.

issueType.description: Issue type name as returned by the ticketing backend (e.g., Bug, Story, Epic, Chore, Spike).

projectKey.description: Project key prefix (e.g., TT). Must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+$.

summary.description: Ticket summary field verbatim from the ticketing backend.

description.description: Ticket description field verbatim from the ticketing backend. Empty string if absent.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given/When/Then clauses extracted from the ticket description. Empty array if none found.

ticketSize.description: Derived ticket size classification used to determine RoutedPhases.

routedPhases.description: Ordered list of phase orchestrator names to invoke, derived from ticketSize.

codebaseContext.description: Bounded-context snapshot appended by codebase-context-agent. Present only after Stage 0 enrichment. Absent if no prior pipeline archive exists.

boundedContexts.description: Deduplicated bounded context names from the most recent pipeline archive and architecture overview.

keyAdrDecisions.description: Titles of the five most recently added ADR entries from the decision log.

establishedPatterns.description: Recurring architectural pattern names identified in the most recent archive artifacts.

technologyStack.description: Technology choices recorded in the most recent architecture-to-domain-modeling artifact.
